text:
Ravi S: Compliance reached out asking for 365d retention for auth/session events and a way to "replay" sequences for audits without exposing PII.
Marta C: storage + egress will bite the budget; do we have a cheaper approach than keeping raw in SIEM?
Evan SRE: idea: keep live SIEM short (90d), mirror raw events to a CMK-encrypted forensic archive with 370d lifecycle. For audits, produce a "playback bundle" (sanitized JSONL + signed manifest) that auditors load into an ephemeral, network-isolated sandbox. No direct SIEM access.
Ravi S: sounds reasonable. How do we control raw read access?
Evan SRE: unwrap flow via kms-proxy + approval service: request -> two approvers (Sec + Compliance/Legal) -> kms-proxy unwrap -> signed bundle URL TTL. All unwraps logged to WORM audit stream.
audit-bot: Ticket created: SEC-5120 - forensic-archive-playback (https://tickets.internal/SEC-5120)
Lena Compliance: Approval policy: external auditors require 2-of-3 [SecLead, Compliance, Legal]. Internal triage can be 1 SecLead + Oncall for short TTL. Also require human review if scrub changes event semantics.
Marta C: cost estimate request: storage delta, egress per export, sandbox compute. I'll prepare numbers for finance.
Evan SRE: implementation sketch (manifest + policy examples):
```
manifest: {
  bundle_id: "2026-07-21-001",
  cmk_key_id: "cmk-arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd",
  bundle_hash: "sha256:...",
  scrub_policy: "mask_all_pii",
  requester: "ravi.s@redwood",
  approvers: ["lena.compliance","seclead"],
  created_at: "2026-07-21T14:00:00Z"
}
unwrap_policy: {
  approvers_required: 2,
  ttl_hours: 12,
  tags: ["external_audit","forensic_playback"]
}
```
Marta C: prefer redact-by-default. Legal must explicitly approve any unredacted or minimally-redacted bundle.
Lena Compliance: auditors want step-through playback (session-level), not raw query. Sandbox should be MFA-only accounts, egress locked, and IP-restricted.
Evan SRE: tokenization keys must rotate separately from CMKs; manifests should include token version so we can validate historical bundles. Also enforce that token-service refuses raw material unless unwrap flow used.
Ravi S: vuln triage note: if an incident needs quick access, create a "triage" tag that allows 4h TTL with stricter justification and immediate oncall notification.
Evan SRE: agreed. All unwrap events include requestor, approvers, justification, bundle_hash, and an audit-sink record.
Marta C: action items:
- Marta: cost estimate + procurement touchpoint (48h)
- Evan: design kms-proxy changes + manifest schema + sample API (72h)
- Lena: draft approver matrix + legal gating text (48h)
- Ravi: open RFC and link to SEC-5120 (ASAP)
Lena Compliance: Quick question: do we allow partner auditors to request custom fields? Prefer no 2, only pre-approved bundle types.
Ravi S: agreed. Controlled bundles only.
audit-bot: SEC-5120 linked to #ops; will post events on bundle creation and unwraps.
Marta C: ack. I'll start finance thread.
Evan SRE: will post design doc when ready.
Ravi S: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
